From 41460a19654c32d39fd0e3a3671cd8d4b7b8479f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ethan Tidmore <ethantidmore06@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Feb 2026 14:54:29 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] staging: rtl8723bs: fix null dereference in find_network

The variable pwlan has the possibility of being NULL when passed into
rtw_free_network_nolock() which would later dereference the variable.

Fixes: 554c0a3abf21 ("staging: Add rtl8723bs sdio wifi driver")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Ethan Tidmore <ethantidmore06@gmail.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260202205429.20181-1-ethantidmore06@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_mlme.c b/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_mlme.c
index b3a9e40054a7..8e98344951ac 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_mlme.c
+++ b/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_mlme.c
@@ -826,8 +826,10 @@ static void find_network(struct adapter *adapter)
 	struct wlan_network *tgt_network = &pmlmepriv->cur_network;
 
 	pwlan = rtw_find_network(&pmlmepriv->scanned_queue, tgt_network->network.mac_address);
-	if (pwlan)
-		pwlan->fixed = false;
+	if (!pwlan)
+		return;
+
+	pwlan->fixed = false;
 
 	if (check_fwstate(pmlmepriv, WIFI_ADHOC_MASTER_STATE) &&
 	    (adapter->stapriv.asoc_sta_count == 1))
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

The patch fixes a null pointer dereference vulnerability in the `find_network` function of the rtl8723bs Wi-Fi driver (staging). The issue occurs when `pwlan` is `NULL` and subsequently passed to `rtw_free_network_nolock()` or used elsewhere in the function.

### File modified:
- `drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_mlme.c`

### Description of changes:
- Added an early return if `pwlan` is `NULL` after calling `rtw_find_network()`.
- The original code only set `pwlan->fixed = false` if `pwlan` was non-NULL but then continued execution, leaving a potential NULL dereference later in the function. The new logic immediately returns when `pwlan` is NULL, and then unconditionally sets `pwlan->fixed = false` for the valid case.

### Relationship:
The fix is a single logical change in one function. It ensures that `find_network` does not proceed with a `NULL` `pwlan`, thereby preventing the subsequent null dereference that could occur in the original code path.

Here is the commit message:
staging: rtl8723bs: fix null dereference in find_network

The variable pwlan has the possibility of being NULL when passed into
rtw_free_network_nolock() which would later dereference the variable.

Fixes: 554c0a3abf21 ("staging: Add rtl8723bs sdio wifi driver")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Ethan Tidmore <ethantidmore06@gmail.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260202205429.20181-1-ethantidmore06@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

Here is the root cause:
The function `find_network` in `rtw_mlme.c` did not properly handle the case where `rtw_find_network` returns NULL, leading to a subsequent null pointer dereference when `pwlan` is used later (e.g., in `rtw_free_network_nolock`). The original code only guarded the assignment `pwlan->fixed = false` but allowed execution to continue, resulting in a null dereference elsewhere.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void find_network(struct adapter *adapter)
 {
 	struct wlan_network *pwlan = NULL;
 	struct	mlme_priv *pmlmepriv = &adapter->mlmepriv;
 	struct wlan_network *tgt_network = &pmlmepriv->cur_network;
 
 	pwlan = rtw_find_network(&pmlmepriv->scanned_queue, tgt_network->network.mac_address);
-	if (pwlan)
-		pwlan->fixed = false;
+	if (!pwlan)
+		return;
+
+	pwlan->fixed = false;
 
 	if (check_fwstate(pmlmepriv, WIFI_ADHOC_MASTER_STATE) &&
 	    (adapter->stapriv.asoc_sta_count == 1))
 		rtw_free_network_nolock(adapter, pwlan);
 }
